data.body: [P2] Add composed coverage for grouped dispatch. The runner tests stop at a mocked Invoke, and the dispatcher tests cover unwrapping and module loading; none exercises this handler with the runner's envelope and a real durable handler. Local example tests bypass this path, so routing, context forwarding, and replay input restoration can regress without failing local checks. CONTRIBUTING requires composed tests for changes spanning components. Add a composed test covering example selection, original input, and suspension followed by replay through the dispatcher.
